what: Mistake: accepted the cutover design (job 20261025-001232-vesh) without working out what the required history check does on a pull request's head after C0; it judges the pull request's own unmerged commits by the attribution rule, so every pull request fails 'the full history' (PR #175).
why: A change to a required check should be tried against a pull request shaped like this repository's before it lands; the cutover's tests ran only on main-shaped histories.
